title: Almond Sunrise Bowl
description: A nutritious and flavorful breakfast bowl featuring almond granola, fresh sunrise fruit, and a drizzle of honey.

ingredients.name: Sunrise Fruit (such as pineapple, mandarin, and kiwi)
Bowl
ingredients.notes: large and clear glass or ceramic

instructions: In a large bowl, combine almond granola and Greek yogurt.
Add diced sunrise fruit on top of the yogurt and granola.
Optional: add sliced almonds or shredded coconut for added crunch and flavor.
